audit.whatIsWrong: The page invented a 'fifteen-second invitation' off Pick a Card and never used a real number anywhere.
audit.why: Pick a Card is 6s at EVERY rank. Wild Cards is 6/5.75/5.5/5.25/5s. Destiny is 170/140/110s. Stacked Deck has no cooldown — it procs every 4th attack.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer taught the WRONG CARD three separate times: wants.foe[0] 'Land blue card stuns', wants.you[0] 'never walk into blue/red card guess range', and late 'if he whiffs blue card'. It also claimed Karma's Q outranges Wild Cards.
audit.why: Gold is the stun card; blue restores mana and red slows. And Wild Cards is a 10000-range line — you do not outrange it, you sidestep the fan. Pick a Card itself only applies at 200 range, so the real gate is his auto range, not his spell range. Per the missingInteractions autoreset-burst-tell rule, Pick a Card is an AUTO-ATTACK RESET: the tell is the attack wind-up, not the card select.
